{{Quote|And we are all aware that Onaconda was a flawed man. He knew better than anyone of his own mistakes, but he never compromised his principles, and what he did, he did for his people. Their needs always came first.|Silood leads Onaconda Farr's funeral|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
The '''funeral of Onaconda Farr''' was held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Farr]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] via [[Poison/Legends|poison]] by his own [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]], who had developed a grudge against him for [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|bringing]] the war to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Silood/Legends|Silood]], another aide to Farr, presided over the ceremonies, and the funeral was guarded by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]]. Among the individuals that attended the ceremony to say goodbye to Farr were Purs and Senators [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], his closest confidants; [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]]; [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and her [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|guard]]; [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]; and many other senators, including [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], and even his political rival, [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]]. After the funeral, Silood departed for Rodia with Farr's body aboard a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]].
